steps.say: Split the pane so the new one is beside it.
steps.hint: Prefix, then v: a vertical divider, panes side by side.
steps.why: Panes split one window; windows are separate tabs.

steps.hint: Prefix, then h: a horizontal divider, panes stacked.
steps.why: v and h name the divider, not the direction — a common trip-up.

steps.say: Split once more without the prefix.
steps.hint: Alt + Enter splits below; Alt + Shift + Enter splits beside. No prefix.
steps.why: Omarchy adds prefix-free splits because you'll do this constantly.

steps.hint: Ctrl + Alt + Arrow moves between panes by direction.
steps.why: Same spatial idea as Hyprland's Super + Arrows.

steps.hint: Add Shift to the focus keys and the divider moves 5 cells.
steps.why: Resize is relative; tap it a few times.

steps.hint: Prefix, then z: the pane fills the window. ZOOM shows in the status bar.
steps.why: Zoom for focus, z again to come back — like Super + F for panes.

steps.hint: Prefix, then x (or Alt + Escape without the prefix).
steps.why: Closing the last pane closes the window.

steps.hint: Prefix, then q re-reads ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf and says 'Configuration reloaded'.
steps.why: After editing tmux.conf you never need to restart Tmux.
